evidence.summary: Changing discrepancy_ratio from 0.5 to 1 increased the score from approximately 0.35-0.49 to 0.71 and changed the outcome from DECLINE to APPROVE.
Changing only the port produced large score differences. Port C produced 0.6430 and DECLINE, while ports B and D produced approximately 0.87-0.89 and APPROVE.
Changing declared_value from 100 to 71 increased the score from 0.8972 to 0.9430, a gain of 0.0458, while the interface identified declared_value as the changed field.
Increasing container_count to 100 produced only a small score change around 0.83, suggesting container_count is not a dominant factor in this tested region.
Changing shipper_years produced only a +0.0003 score change, indicating a very small effect in the tested region.
